title: Session view (session dial-in & activity)
notes: Founder ran the design-review loop in the :8098 viewer (12 rounds). REFRAMED twice: (1) session = streaming human+agent conversation, not a controls+activity panel; (2) session and conversation are ONE shared component (PartList/ConversationSurface) — a session is a slightly different FORM of conversation. Concept revisited (Part union extends with tool+reasoning kinds; streaming/queue/diff-reuse contracts). Design redone on the content-rendering axis (how tool calls + every session aspect display), NOT placement (placement is settled: session OpenTarget + ConversationSurface). Approved direction: 'Session View' (calm, folded-aggregation). Founder approved 2026-06-22. UNIFIED MESSAGE PATTERN now lives in the shared PartList: only my own messages right-bound+grey-box (capped width, header above box top-left), everyone else (other humans + agents) left-plain; round avatars green=agent/grey=human; session reference split from attachments; agent star glyph removed. This FIXED the AM1 conversation (was missing avatars + the self-box) at the source. Remaining = BUILD: render the session through the real PartList (extend PartKind union with tool+reasoning, wire derivePartsFromSession), then tests + DOM-snapshot re-bless + verify green.
buildScope: Extend PartKind union: tool + reasoning kinds (closed, exhaustive, unknown fallback)
derivePartsFromSession adapter over normalized session activity (ActivityEntry)
Tool-run aggregation (renderer grouping beside groupParts): all completed fold incl. failures, only running standalone, aggregate signals failures
File diffs reuse ReviewCodeDiff via diff Embed (no new diff renderer)
Composer pills from HarnessCapabilityDescriptor (no per-backend branching)
Queued message: pre-Part FIFO state, non-interrupting, delivers to a prose Part
Render session through the shared PartList (self-right pattern) — no parallel renderer
Re-bless PartList/ConversationSurface/catalog DOM snapshots; update PartList tests for the new avatar/self-box/embed structure
